scope: offline off-home access desired-policy validation, shared management API, and CLI preview
behavior: Requires explicit private transport, bounded client/target/capability references, and a bounded session TTL for private_transport.
Credential reference must use the credential_ref_ ID shape; client, capability, and credential reference values are omitted from previews.
Management API exposes only the allowlisted read-only preview operation; CLI stdin requires explicit --policy-stdin and valid piped JSON.
Private transport preview remains unavailable because no reviewed transport adapter exists; it never claims remote access active.
limitations: No VPN/tunnel provider was selected or implemented.
No config is persisted and no transport adapter consumes the policy for connection setup.
No device, router, listener, or external network qualification was performed.
This preview integration does not establish P3 completion or change P4 ownership/handoff gates.
